summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric utility, filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share buyback under Argentine Capital Markets Law. On September 8, 2026, it repurchased 200,000 book-entry common shares (ARS 1 par, 1 vote each) on BYMA at an average price of ARS 2,228.84 per share, totaling ARS 445,769,094 (~USD equivalent not stated). The repurchase did not exceed 25% of the prior 90-day average daily trading volume, consistent with routine treasury repurchases. This is a periodic capital-return disclosure, not part of a broader special-situation transaction. Watch for cumulative buyback scope relative to announced programs and potential volume threshold breaches.
